Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files with extensions .xxx, .ttt, .micro, .mp3, or encrypted files without an extension
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with TeslaCrypt encrypted files
Indicators of Compromise: Master TeslaCrypt decryption key released on TeslaCrypt payment site
Encrypted files with extensions .xxx, .ttt, .micro, .mp3, or no extension
Encrypted files with .TeslaBackup extension as backup
